options.content:
## FT Pipeline Dashboard

**Live sections:** LLM interaction collection (V0002), Phase 10 benchmark history (V0012 `benchmark_runs`/`benchmark_results`), LLM endpoint health (V0018, Phase 13.5 watchdog).

**TSDB-CONSUME-001 (2026-06-11):** the Model Version Timeline, Benchmark Scores, Training Cycle History, and Exogenous Ratio panels were **removed** — they read `ft_model_versions` / `ft_benchmarks` / `ft_training_cycles`, which have **no writer** (0 rows ever). The tables remain: they are the designated sinks for the FT recursive-retraining loop (FT Phases 6/7/9 — NOT STARTED; trigger: FT-CLASSIFY-002). Restore the panels from git history when that loop ships writers.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time_bucket('$__interval', time) AS time,
  COUNT(*) / EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM '$__interval'::interval) AS rate
FROM llm_interactions
WHERE space_id = '$space_id'
  AND $__timeFilter(time)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Latest Benchmark Age
panels.description: Days since the most recent benchmark_runs.completed_at. FT-BENCH-REFRESH-001 (2026-07-20): nothing schedules the benchmark automatically today (FT-RECURSIVE-002 default-off), so operators can miss that the 'Latest Run' panel below reads a row from weeks ago. Red at >7 days (matches the default `FT_BENCH_STALENESS_DAYS` config + `ft_benchmark_stale` alert rule).

targets.rawSql:
-- FT-BENCH-REFRESH-001: freshness gauge over benchmark_runs.
SELECT COALESCE(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - MAX(completed_at))) / 86400.0, 999.0) AS age_days
FROM benchmark_runs
WHERE completed_at IS NOT NULL

panels.title: Phase 10 Benchmark — Per-Task Pass Rate (latest run)
panels.description: Reads benchmark_results (V0012). Score = mean of deterministic reward_vector entries across N runs per task, for the most recent run_id. See adjacent 'Latest Benchmark Age' panel for freshness — FT-BENCH-REFRESH-001 wired a staleness gauge + alert so operators know when this table is drifting stale.

targets.rawSql:
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT run_id FROM benchmark_runs
  ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 1
),
per_row AS (
  SELECT
    br.task_id,
    br.sampling_group,
    br.run_idx,
    (
      SELECT AVG((v)::float)
      FROM jsonb_each_text(br.reward_vector) AS kv(k, v)
      WHERE v ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$'
    ) AS row_scalar
  FROM benchmark_results br
  JOIN latest l ON br.run_id = l.run_id
)
SELECT
  task_id,
  MAX(sampling_group) AS sampling_group,
  COUNT(*) AS n_runs,
  ROUND(AVG(row_scalar)::numeric, 4) AS mean_score,
  ROUND(MIN(row_scalar)::numeric, 4) AS min_score,
  ROUND(MAX(row_scalar)::numeric, 4) AS max_score
FROM per_row
GROUP BY task_id
ORDER BY task_id

panels.title: Phase 10 Benchmark — Per-Task Reward Variance (stddev)
panels.description: Reads benchmark_results (V0012). Stddev of the per-run scalar reward across N runs for each task in the most recent benchmark — Phase 11 GRPO uses this as advantage-normalization denominator.

targets.rawSql:
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT run_id FROM benchmark_runs
  ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 1
),
per_row AS (
  SELECT
    br.task_id,
    br.run_idx,
    (
      SELECT AVG((v)::float)
      FROM jsonb_each_text(br.reward_vector) AS kv(k, v)
      WHERE v ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$'
    ) AS row_scalar
  FROM benchmark_results br
  JOIN latest l ON br.run_id = l.run_id
)
SELECT
  task_id AS metric,
  ROUND(COALESCE(STDDEV_POP(row_scalar), 0)::numeric, 4) AS value
FROM per_row
GROUP BY task_id
ORDER BY task_id

panels.title: Phase 10 Benchmark — Stagnation Flag (latest)
panels.description: Reads benchmark_runs.stagnation_flag for the most recent run. Phase 10 informational-only; becomes blocking in Phase 11 once benchmark_runs count >= 3.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  started_at AS time,
  CASE WHEN stagnation_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS value
FROM benchmark_runs
ORDER BY started_at DESC
LIMIT 1

panels.title: Phase 10 Benchmark — Aggregate Weighted Score (history)
panels.description: Reads benchmark_runs.aggregate_weighted_score over time. Group-weighted score (T:0.50 / C:0.35 / J:0.15). Stagnation threshold = |delta| < 0.005 across last 3.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  started_at AS time,
  aggregate_weighted_score AS value,
  model_path AS metric
FROM benchmark_runs
WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at)
ORDER BY started_at

panels.title: LLM Output Quality (HITL-graded)

targets.rawSql:
-- HITL grades on llm:* datasets (HITL-REVIEW-001 review_grades)
SELECT time_bucket('$__interval', time) AS time,
  AVG(gold_score) AS value
FROM review_grades
WHERE dataset_id LIKE 'llm:%'
  AND $__timeFilter(time)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Average HITL gold_score across llm:* call-site datasets (review_grades, HITL-REVIEW-001). Replaces the writerless 'Entropy Health' panel, which read llm_interactions.quality — a column that was NULL on all 91,468 rows ever ('populated post-hoc by annotation job' — the job was never built; the honest producer is HITL grading). Sparse until review cadence picks up; 'No HITL grades in window' is the truthful empty state.

panels.title: LLM endpoint state (0=up, 1=degraded, 2=down)
panels.description: Continuous watchdog state gauge. DASHBOARD-TRUTH-002 E9 (2026-07-20): now reads mdemg_mlx_health_state from metric_samples (continuous, emitted every 5s by the supervised watchdog) instead of the transition-log llm_endpoint_health_events (which returned zero rows during steady-state UP → panel read 'No data' for 15+ days on a healthy endpoint). Transition events are now overlaid as annotations, so you see both the continuous state AND transition markers.

targets.rawSql:
-- DASHBOARD-TRUTH-002 E9: continuous gauge (not transition log) — panel is 'No data'-free in steady-state UP.
SELECT time,
       value,
       COALESCE(labels->>'endpoint_url', 'llm-endpoint') AS metric
FROM metric_samples
WHERE metric_name = 'mdemg_mlx_health_state'
  AND metric_type = 'gauge'
  AND $__timeFilter(time)
ORDER BY time

panels.title: State transitions in window
panels.description: Count of watchdog state changes (up↔degraded↔down) in selected time range. Steady state should be 0; transitions indicate endpoint instability.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM llm_endpoint_health_events WHERE event_kind = 'state_transition' AND $__timeFilter(recorded_at)

panels.title: Fast-fail bursts in window
panels.description: Number of 30s windows where the llmclient fast-fail gate engaged (i.e. caller asked for an LLM while watchdog state was Down). Each row aggregates short-circuits in its window; rows = bursts.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM llm_endpoint_health_events WHERE event_kind = 'fast_fail_burst' AND $__timeFilter(recorded_at)

panels.title: Recent watchdog events (last 30)
panels.description: Forensic view: when did each transition happen, what error triggered it, what was the state machine doing. probe_recovery rows mark down→up healing events; fast_fail_burst rows mark llmclient short-circuit windows. DASHBOARD-TRUTH-002 E10 (2026-07-20): dropped the $__timeFilter — this is a RARE-event stream (12 lifetime events on mdemg-dev, newest ~15 days ago) so a narrow dashboard time range showed 'No data'. Now always shows the last 30 events regardless of range.

targets.rawSql:
-- DASHBOARD-TRUTH-002 E10: no time-window filter (rare-event stream; newest event may be >30d ago).
SELECT recorded_at AS "time", endpoint_url, event_kind, from_state, to_state, state_numeric, consecutive_failures, burst_short_circuits, LEFT(COALESCE(error_message, ''), 120) AS error FROM llm_endpoint_health_events ORDER BY recorded_at DESC LIMIT 30

panels.title: Production Drift (active score − latest benchmark)
panels.description: FT-RECURSIVE-004 E2: GREATEST(0, active ft_model_versions score − latest benchmark aggregate). 0 = no drift (or no-data gate). Alert ft_production_drift fires above the margin (default 0.05).

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE WHEN COALESCE((SELECT MAX(overall_score) FROM ft_model_versions WHERE status = 'active'), 0) <= 0 THEN 0 WHEN (SELECT MAX(completed_at) FROM benchmark_runs) IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE GREATEST(0, COALESCE((SELECT MAX(overall_score) FROM ft_model_versions WHERE status = 'active'), 0) - COALESCE((SELECT MAX(aggregate_weighted_score) FROM benchmark_runs WHERE completed_at = (SELECT MAX(completed_at) FROM benchmark_runs)), 0)) END AS drift

panels.title: Model Versions (ft_model_versions)
panels.description: FT-RECURSIVE-003/004 reader-writer pair: every serving swap records a row (active/superseded/rolled_back).

targets.rawSql: SELECT deployed_at, version, status, round(COALESCE(overall_score,0)::numeric,4) AS score, training_cycle FROM ft_model_versions ORDER BY deployed_at DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Retrain Cycle Ledger (latest status per cycle)
panels.description: FT-RECURSIVE-002+ event-sourced ledger — latest event per cycle via DISTINCT ON (never raw event-row counts; the ledger-semantics rule).

targets.rawSql: WITH latest AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (cycle_id) cycle_id, status, COALESCE(stage,'') AS stage, time FROM ft_training_cycles ORDER BY cycle_id, time DESC) SELECT time, cycle_id, status, stage FROM latest ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 20

list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT labels->>'instance' AS __value, labels->>'instance' AS __text FROM metric_samples WHERE labels->>'instance' IS NOT NULL AND time > now() - interval '24 hours' ORDER BY 1

list.query: SELECT DISTINCT space_id FROM metric_samples WHERE time > now() - interval '24 hours' AND ($instance = '' OR labels->>'instance' = '$instance') ORDER BY 1
